name: screen-ocr
title: Screen OCR
description: Select an area of the screen, recognize the text with Tesseract and copy it to the clipboard. Works on GNOME Wayland via the XDG screenshot portal.
author: eliasthecactus

commands.name: recognize-text
commands.title: Recognize Text
commands.subtitle: Screen OCR
commands.description: Select an area of the screen and copy the recognized text

commands.name: recognize-text-clipboard
commands.title: Recognize Text from Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Screen OCR
commands.description: Run OCR on the image in the clipboard (e.g. after Print Screen) and copy the text

commands.name: recognize-text-fullscreen
commands.title: Recognize Text Fullscreen
commands.subtitle: Screen OCR
commands.description: Capture the whole screen and copy the recognized text

commands.name: detect-barcode
commands.title: Detect Barcode / QR Code
commands.subtitle: Screen OCR
commands.description: Select an area of the screen and copy the decoded QR code or barcode

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Languages
preferences.description: Tesseract language codes joined with '+', e.g. 'eng', 'eng+deu', 'deu+fra+ita'. Each needs its package (sudo apt install tesseract-ocr-deu).

preferences.name: keepLineBreaks
preferences.title: Line Breaks
preferences.label: Keep line breaks from the image
preferences.description: When off, lines in the same paragraph are joined with spaces.

preferences.name: captureMethod
preferences.title: Capture Method
preferences.description: How screenshots are taken. Auto uses the XDG desktop portal (GNOME's screenshot UI) and falls back to gnome-screenshot if the portal fails.

preferences.name: upscale
preferences.title: Upscale
preferences.label: Upscale small captures before OCR (needs ImageMagick)
preferences.description: Tesseract is much more accurate on screen text when the image is enlarged 2x. Skipped if ImageMagick is not installed.

preferences.name: keepScreenshot
preferences.title: Screenshots
preferences.label: Keep the screenshot file
preferences.description: The portal saves captures to your Pictures folder. When off, the file is deleted after recognition.
